model.shoply.int_orders_with_payments.name: int_orders_with_payments
model.shoply.int_orders_with_payments.description: Orders joined to their settled payments and refunds. One row per order.
model.shoply.int_orders_with_payments.raw_code:
select o.order_id, o.account_id, o.ordered_at, o.status,
       coalesce(p.paid_usd, 0) as paid_usd, coalesce(r.refunded_usd, 0) as refunded_usd,
       coalesce(p.paid_usd, 0) - coalesce(r.refunded_usd, 0) as net_usd
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} o
left join (select order_id, sum(amount) as paid_usd from {{ ref('stg_payments') }} where status = 'settled' group by 1) p on p.order_id = o.order_id
left join (select pay.order_id, sum(rf.amount) as refunded_usd from {{ ref('stg_refunds') }} rf join {{ ref('stg_payments') }} pay on pay.payment_id = rf.payment_id group by 1) r on r.order_id = o.order_id
model.shoply.int_orders_with_payments.compiled_code:
select o.order_id, o.account_id, o.ordered_at, o.status,
       coalesce(p.paid_usd, 0) as paid_usd, coalesce(r.refunded_usd, 0) as refunded_usd,
       coalesce(p.paid_usd, 0) - coalesce(r.refunded_usd, 0) as net_usd
from analytics.staging.stg_orders o
left join (select order_id, sum(amount) as paid_usd from analytics.staging.stg_payments where status = 'settled' group by 1) p on p.order_id = o.order_id
left join (select pay.order_id, sum(rf.amount) as refunded_usd from analytics.staging.stg_refunds rf join analytics.staging.stg_payments pay on pay.payment_id = rf.payment_id group by 1) r on r.order_id = o.order_id

model.shoply.int_customer_daily_spend.name: int_customer_daily_spend
model.shoply.int_customer_daily_spend.description: Net settled spend per customer per UTC day, attributed by the account owner at order time.
model.shoply.int_customer_daily_spend.raw_code:
select m.customer_id, cast(convert_timezone('UTC', o.ordered_at) as date) as order_day,
       sum(o.net_usd) as net_usd, count(*) as order_count
from {{ ref('int_orders_with_payments') }} o
join {{ ref('int_customer_identity') }} m
  on m.account_id = o.account_id and o.ordered_at >= m.valid_from and (m.valid_to is null or o.ordered_at < m.valid_to)
group by 1, 2
model.shoply.int_customer_daily_spend.compiled_code:

       sum(o.net_usd) as net_usd, count(*) as order_count
from analytics.intermediate.int_orders_with_payments o
join analytics.intermediate.int_customer_identity m
  on m.account_id = o.account_id and o.ordered_at >= m.valid_from and (m.valid_to is null or o.ordered_at < m.valid_to)
group by 1, 2

left join analytics.intermediate.int_customer_daily_spend d on d.customer_id = c.customer_id and d.order_day >= dateadd(day, -90, current_date()) and d.order_day < current_date()
group by 1

model.shoply.daily_revenue.name: daily_revenue
model.shoply.daily_revenue.description: Gross settled payments, refunds, and net revenue per UTC day.
model.shoply.daily_revenue.raw_code:
with p as (select cast(convert_timezone('UTC', paid_at) as date) as day, sum(amount) as gross_usd from {{ ref('fct_payments') }} group by 1),
     r as (select cast(convert_timezone('UTC', refunded_at) as date) as day, sum(amount) as refunds_usd from {{ ref('fct_refunds') }} group by 1)
select p.day, p.gross_usd, coalesce(r.refunds_usd, 0) as refunds_usd, p.gross_usd - coalesce(r.refunds_usd, 0) as net_usd
from p left join r on r.day = p.day
model.shoply.daily_revenue.compiled_code:

select p.day, p.gross_usd, coalesce(r.refunds_usd, 0) as refunds_usd, p.gross_usd - coalesce(r.refunds_usd, 0) as net_usd
from p left join r on r.day = p.day

model.shoply.campaign_attribution.name: campaign_attribution
model.shoply.campaign_attribution.description: Orders and revenue attributed to campaigns by last session before the order.
model.shoply.campaign_attribution.raw_code:
select c.campaign_id, c.name as campaign_name, c.channel, count(distinct o.order_id) as orders, sum(o.net_usd) as revenue_usd, any_value(c.spend_usd) as spend_usd
from {{ ref('stg_marketing_campaigns') }} c
join {{ ref('fct_sessions') }} s on s.utm_campaign = c.name
join {{ ref('fct_orders') }} o on o.customer_id = s.customer_id and o.ordered_at between s.started_at and dateadd(hour, 24, s.started_at)
group by 1, 2, 3
model.shoply.campaign_attribution.compiled_code:

from analytics.staging.stg_marketing_campaigns c
join analytics.marts.fct_sessions s on s.utm_campaign = c.name
join analytics.marts.fct_orders o on o.customer_id = s.customer_id and o.ordered_at between s.started_at and dateadd(hour, 24, s.started_at)
group by 1, 2, 3

model.shoply.inventory_health.name: inventory_health
model.shoply.inventory_health.description: Days of cover per product from latest inventory and trailing 30-day units.
model.shoply.inventory_health.raw_code:
with inv as (select product_id, sum(on_hand - reserved) as on_hand from {{ ref('stg_inventory_snapshots') }} where snapshot_date = (select max(snapshot_date) from {{ ref('stg_inventory_snapshots') }}) group by 1),
     u as (select product_id, sum(units) as units_30d from {{ ref('product_sales_daily') }} where order_day >= dateadd(day, -30, current_date()) group by 1)
select inv.product_id, inv.on_hand, coalesce(u.units_30d, 0) as units_30d, inv.on_hand / nullif(u.units_30d / 30.0, 0) as days_of_cover
from inv left join u on u.product_id = inv.product_id
model.shoply.inventory_health.compiled_code:
with inv as (select product_id, sum(on_hand - reserved) as on_hand from analytics.staging.stg_inventory_snapshots where snapshot_date = (select max(snapshot_date) from analytics.staging.stg_inventory_snapshots) group by 1),
     u as (select product_id, sum(units) as units_30d from analytics.marts.product_sales_daily where order_day >= dateadd(day, -30, current_date()) group by 1)
select inv.product_id, inv.on_hand, coalesce(u.units_30d, 0) as units_30d, inv.on_hand / nullif(u.units_30d / 30.0, 0) as days_of_cover
from inv left join u on u.product_id = inv.product_id

model.shoply.cohort_retention.name: cohort_retention
model.shoply.cohort_retention.description: Share of each first-order-month cohort that ordered again in each later month.
model.shoply.cohort_retention.raw_code:
select date_trunc('month', c.first_order_day)::date as cohort_month,
       datediff('month', c.first_order_day, d.order_day) as months_since,
       count(distinct c.customer_id) as customers, count(distinct d.customer_id) as retained
from {{ ref('dim_customers') }} c left join {{ ref('int_customer_daily_spend') }} d on d.customer_id = c.customer_id
group by 1, 2
